# Zone index

All 59 zones that have at least one teleport point to ANOTHER zone, grouped by family (the same grouping as the [world map](/zones/map/)) — the card links to the zone's page. Zones without any inter-zone teleport point (the strongholds, the PvP arena, dead-end gate islands) are left off; they are still reachable from the world map's gate lines. The per-family pages — [Alpha](/zones/alpha/) · [Beta](/zones/beta/) · [Gamma](/zones/gamma/) — list every zone of the family regardless of TPs.

<a id="training"></a>

## Training

The virtual [training island](/zones/zone-training/) — where new characters start and learn the basics before entering the main galaxies.
